text: MitosisEngine calibration defect (independent of the retired decoder phase): split_threshold ships at 0.3 while the engine's median tension is ~0.005 and the measurement-derived bar is 0.0397 — 7.6x too high. Threshold-driven mitosis has never fired on any path in this repo; mitosis.demo()'s single MITOSIS line is a forced split_cell() call. Fix on its own terms. Also open: MitosisC.__init__ force-grows by cloning cells[0], which merge_cells then deletes.

CORPUS DEFECT (upstream of ConsciousLM/AnimaLM, not just the QD series): data/corpus_v2.txt has no natural language anywhere. 41.7% arithmetic drills; the dialogue is 360,398 lines but 190 UNIQUE (one block repeated 2538x); deduplicated prose has type/token 0.24% (ko, 2074 types / 870k tokens) and 0.14% (en, 1728 types / 1.22M tokens) against a natural 1-3%; top bigrams occur at exactly 3000 each. Any semantic capability is blocked upstream until this is replaced. Measured in docs/hypotheses/QD-10.
